in_sanskrit.name: Meraz
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Light, Luminous
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Meraz एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'mṛga', meaning 'light' or 'luminous'. In Hindu mythology, Meraz is a name associated with the god Vishnu, who is often depicted as the preserver of light and knowledge. The name carries the spiritual message of illumination and enlightenment.
